title: Money roadmap, next 12 months
how: Lifecycle Monte Carlo (tools/money_roadmap.py): 5-session blocks of the real 2026 sessions, 21 sessions = 1 model month, one sample drives all accounts together. Cash in = payouts to the owner at the MFFU 80% split; cash out = eval fees at the owner's real prices ($91.80 / $63 / $43, $0 activation) and the new eval every breach buys (reset fee unknown: priced as a new eval). The three evals running now are already paid ('sunk'), so they are not in the cash out. H1 = Jan-Jun 2026 (pick half), H2 = Jul-Oct 2026 (check half). H2 is the conservative one.

verdict.do_first: ATLAS on the 25K first: it is the first cash (typical first payout 2026-12-21 conservative) and pays its price back in month 2. Run all three accounts at once (LIT 50K, ATLAS 25K, BLITZ 25K): buying all three on day 1 beats every staggered order, and the fees are only $198.
verdict.then: LIT on the 50K second: the biggest total ($6,549 in 12 months) but its first payout is later. BLITZ is the weakest of the three ($2,318): a second ATLAS or a LIT copy would earn more in that slot. When an account has been paid its 5th payout (it then moves to a live account), buy the next ATLAS 25K eval ($43) first: a re-buy adds $3,087 (conservative) in the year, against $544 for LIT and $194 for BLITZ.
verdict.first_payout: First payout from any account: typical 2026-12-16 (conservative, Jul-Oct) to 2026-12-03 (Jan-Jun); 1 in 10 paths already by 2026-11-18 / 2026-11-23, 9 in 10 by 2026-12-31 / 2027-01-27. It comes from ATLAS (typical 2026-12-21 conservative, 2026-12-04 Jan-Jun); LIT on the 50K comes later (typical 2027-02-09 / 2027-01-22).
verdict.month12: Cash to the owner by month 12 (2027-11-05), after every fee including the $198 already paid for the three evals: conservative (Jul-Oct) middle path $13,105, worst case (1 path in 10) $9,759, best case (1 in 10) $14,892; Jan-Jun version middle $14,345, worst $11,820, best $15,370. The worst of all 3,000 sampled paths still ends at $3,512 (H2); no path ends below $0.
verdict.with_recycle: If the owner buys a new eval each time an account has been paid 5 times: $16,546 middle path conservative ($12,060 worst / $21,063 best), $22,414 Jan-Jun.
verdict.caps: The money is front-loaded: each account stops paying after 5 payouts (5 x $1,000 x 80% = $4,000 on a 25K, 5 x $2,000 x 80% = $8,000 on the 50K, then it moves to a live account that this table does not count), so months 8-12 fall off unless a new eval is bought.
